scope: Material and lexical evidence ablation, not a human preference study

fixedRules: Same nine families, maximum 24 each, unchanged aesthetics and round-robin selector. Require disjoint full edge-anchored action/object roots. No semantic-neighbor proof, no padding, no default switch.
review: Assistant editorial only, first listed seed; no best-of-three picking or promotion claim. No tuning from evaluation outputs.
